frozen embryo transfer (FET) without a corpus luteum
frozen embryo transfer (FET) with an artificial cycle (AC-FET)

Frozen embryo transfer (FET) with natural/modified natural/stimulated cycle (CL-FET)
cohort: 1168 singleton pregnancies and live births following FET
finding: The risk of HDP and several other maternal complications, including placental retention, appears to be increased after AC-FET compared with CL-FET.
mod_finding: The study found an increased incidence of cesarean sections in the artificial cycle frozen embryo transfer group compared to the natural/modified natural/stimulated cycle frozen embryo transfer group.
